root_cause: The container used host.docker.internal for a LiteLLM listener published only on host loopback under the native Docker daemon. The AnythingLLM update-embeddings endpoint returned HTTP 200 while swallowing per-document embedding failures, leaving the vector namespace empty.
runner_defects_fixed: The runner now accepts an explicit Docker network and container-reachable LiteLLM base URL.
The runner now requires the final vector count to be at least the input document count before warmup or quality scoring.
